product.name: Trii Investment App
product.description: A mobile application that enables retail investors in Latin America to invest in Colombian and international stocks and collective investment funds.

product.name: TriiPro Subscription Service
product.description: A premium subscription offering discounted commissions, expert investment reports, personalized support, and advanced trading features like stop loss and take profit orders.

product.name: Collective Investment Funds
product.description: Investment funds that pool money from multiple investors to invest in diversified portfolios, including index funds like the S&P 500 and sector-specific funds.

identifier.value: Access to Local and Global Stocks and ETFs

product.name: Access to Local and Global Stocks and ETFs
product.description: A platform feature enabling users to buy and sell shares of Colombian and international companies, including ETFs and ADRs, directly from the app.

product.name: Financial Education and Market Insights
product.description: Educational content and market analysis provided through blogs, reports, and newsletters to help investors make informed decisions.
